title: The Canon of Ruinous Fire
summary: A canon of fire taught at the edge of what a Xiantian field can bear: it ends in a ruin that leaves nothing standing in reach.

title: The Folio of the Core Furnace
summary: A folio for the formed Core that makes the Core itself a furnace and spends its heat in destruction beyond the field.

title: The Codex of the Final Pyre
summary: A codex of divine fire that judges and burns and cleanses; it ends in a pyre at the scale of the realm that raises it.
